title: Guitar-playing family on both sides
summary: His grandfather, father and uncles all played guitar and string music in a French-speaking family band.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you tell us anything about your parents? Have they played music? Your father or any brothers or any one?

Well, my grandfather, he played guitar. All my uncles, aunts on my father's side. My father, he played guitar. Played guitar. And I had one uncle on my mother's side. He played guitar, which was Eugene. Oh. That's my middle name. Maybe after he was a guitar player.
That was like a six string guitar?
